projecthero.jei.wizard_shazam: Creative and operators only. Spawns Wizard Shazam, who judges whoever right-clicks him and gives the pure of heart the power. In survival, players earn Shazam through the journey: with full Valor and no powers, a ghostly subway stairway now and then appears ahead of them. Walk down it.

projecthero.guide.shazam.getting.body: The Wizard chooses the pure of heart. Fill your Valor (heroic deeds done while you have no powers; see Becoming Thor) and stay free of every power. Once you're worthy, now and then (more often at night and in a City) a ghostly subway stairway appears a little way ahead of you. Only you can see it, and it fades after half a minute. Walk down to it and you're taken to an old station. Board the train that comes and it carries you to the Rock of Eternity, where Wizard Shazam waits on his throne. Go before him, and when he asks, say his name (the button, Enter, or Shazam typed in chat). The lightning makes you his champion (it becomes your Primary power) and you're sent back to where you first saw the stairway. Your Valor isn't spent, but once you're Shazam you can no longer become Thor. Random serums never give it.
